prompt: I want to use Terraform to fetch secrets from Infisical without them being stored in the Terraform state file. Show me the full HCL configuration.

assertions.text: Mentions Terraform v1.10+ requirement for ephemeral resources
Uses machine identity authentication (universal auth or OIDC, not service tokens)
Includes env_slug and workspace_id parameters in the ephemeral resource
Explains that ephemeral resources prevent secrets from being stored in state files
